{{Otheruses|Totem}}
'''Totems of Familiars''' were [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] artifacts blessed with [[Dathomir Magic|magic]] that called an animal to the wielder's side. These familiars helped crafters accomplish some of the most difficult magic. A [[Familiar (Nightsister)/Legends|Familiar]] [[Spirit (Nightsisters)|spirit]] could be summoned by using a Totem.
